errors.message: `test.fail` sets both max and counter: a named counter's max goes under counters
`test.pass` → `$done` sets max, but there is no loop to bound
counter name 'test.fail' is not a valid name: a dotted name is derived from its edge, never declared
counter 'review.changes_requested' is not declared in counters
shared/mx.yaml: exit `back` of `verify` is fed by edges of different kinds (check fail: `test.fail`; gate reject: `ready.reject`): give max: on `verify`'s route
`rev2.rejected` → `$stuck` sets max, but there is no loop to bound

a1.source:
name: a1
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: test
    means:
      done: built
  test:
    check: bun test
    timeout: 5m
    exits:
      "3": stale
      "4": flaky
    outcomes:
      pass: $done
      fail:
        to: implement
        counter: test.fail
      flaky:
        to: implement
        counter: test.flaky
      stale:
        to: implement
        counter: test.stale
counters:
  test.fail:
    max: 5
  test.flaky:
    max: 5
  test.stale:
    max: 10

a10.source:
name: a10
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: integrate
    means:
      done: built
  integrate:
    integrate: null
    outcomes:
      done: $done
      conflict:
        to: implement
        counter: integrate.conflict
counters:
  integrate.conflict:
    max: 5
    reset_on: integrate.done

a2.source:
name: a2
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: ready
    means:
      done: built
  ready:
    gate: ok?
    outcomes:
      approve: integrate
      reject:
        to: implement
        counter: ready.reject
      stale:
        to: implement
        counter: ready.stale
  integrate:
    integrate: null
    outcomes:
      done: wait
      conflict:
        to: fix
        counter: integrate.conflict
  fix:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: integrate
    means:
      done: fixed
  wait:
    check: "true"
    timeout: 5m
    exits:
      "3": stale
    outcomes:
      pass: merge
      fail: $stuck
      stale:
        to: implement
        counter: wait.stale
  merge:
    await-merge: null
    outcomes:
      stale:
        to: implement
        counter: merge.stale
counters:
  ready.reject:
    max: 2
  ready.stale:
    max: 10
  integrate.conflict:
    max: 2
    reset_on: integrate.done
  wait.stale:
    max: 10
  merge.stale:
    max: 10

a3.source:
name: a3
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: review
    means:
      done: built
  review:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      approve: report
      changes_requested:
        to: implement
        counter: review.changes_requested
    means:
      approve: ok
      changes_requested: redo
  report:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: $done
      blocked: $stuck
      more: other
    means:
      done: ok
      blocked: no
      more: x
  other:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: $done
    means:
      done: ok
counters:
  review.changes_requested:
    max: 3

b1.source:
name: b1
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it

      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: t1
    means:
      done: built
  t1:
    check: bun test
    timeout: 5m
    outcomes:
      pass: t2
      fail:
        to: implement
        counter: base-update.broken
  t2:
    check: bun test
    timeout: 5m
    outcomes:
      pass: t3

        to: implement
        counter: base-update.broken

b2.source:
name: b2
start: implement
steps:
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: g
    means:
      done: built
  g:
    gate: ok?
    outcomes:
      approve: s
      reject:
        to: implement
        counter: gate.rejected
  s:
    check: "true"
    timeout: 5m
    exits:
      "3": stale
    outcomes:
      pass: d
      fail: $stuck
      stale:
        to: implement
        counter: gate.behind
  d:
    agent: x
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: $done
      again:
        to: implement
        counter: gate.fwd
    means:
      done: ok
      again: x
counters:
  gate.rejected:
    max: 2
  gate.behind:
    max: 3
  gate.fwd:
    max: 3

b3.source:
name: b3
start: up
steps:
  up:
    update-branch: null
    outcomes:
      done: implement
      clean: implement
      conflict:
        to: fix
        counter: sync.clash
  implement:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: $done
    means:
      done: built
  fix:
    agent: do it
    skills:
      - norn-implement
    outcomes:
      done: up
    means:
      done: fixed
counters:
  sync.clash:
    max: 2
    reset_on:
      - up.done
      - up.clean
